author: nanouai
title: Understand the household budget
blurb: Six months of spending sorted into categories, in a spreadsheet in Drive.
sample: Groceries are a third of your spending, and two subscriptions went up this spring.
firstMessage: Help me understand our household budget: look at the last 6 months of the bank account, sort spending into categories and make a spreadsheet in Drive. Then tell me where the money goes.
